integration_issues.issue: Invalid credentials in the glassmorphic LoginModal cause the user to be redirected off the landing page to /login (standalone login page), instead of showing an error toast and keeping the modal open on the landing page. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js response interceptor blindly does `window.location.href = '/login'` for ANY 401, including the /auth/login endpoint itself. Fix: skip redirect when the failing request URL ends with '/auth/login', e.g. `if (err.config?.url?.endsWith('/auth/login')) return Promise.reject(err);` before the redirect. This preserves the modal UX from the landing page.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js response interceptor, exempt POST /auth/login from the 401→/login hard-navigation so a failed login inside the LoginModal shows a toast and keeps the modal open on the landing page. Currently, any wrong password from the landing modal boots the user to the standalone /login page — losing the marketing context that Part 1 was designed to preserve.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js: single global 401 handler is too coarse — it converts every unauthorized response, including the initial login attempt itself, into a hard redirect. Consider whitelisting the auth endpoint and/or using a scoped axios instance for auth calls.

InvoiceForm: switching invoice-level price_type currently rewrites ALL existing lines' price_type, silently overriding any per-item override the user has already set. Consider adding a confirmation or applying invoice-level default only to newly-added lines to avoid data loss for advanced users.

server.py compute_invoice_totals: inclusive+discount semantics — code does `billed = line_gross - it.discount` and then divides by (1+tax) — this treats the discount as a discount on the INCLUSIVE amount. Please document that the discount is inclusive of tax for inclusive lines (contrast with exclusive lines where discount reduces taxable base pre-tax). Not a bug, but worth a code comment for future maintainers.
No DELETE /api/invoices/{id} endpoint exists — test/QA cleanup requires direct mongo access. Consider adding an admin-only soft-delete for QA/rollback scenarios.

rca of the issue: LoginModal invalid-creds UX bug — axios global response interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (lines 17-20) triggers `window.location.href='/login'` for every 401 response including the login POST itself. When a user enters wrong credentials in the modal, backend returns 401, the interceptor fires BEFORE the LoginModal's catch block can render the toast, and the browser navigates away from the Landing page to the standalone /login page. Reproduction: open landing, click header-login-btn, enter any wrong creds, submit → observe url changes to /login and modal disappears. Mitigation: `if (err.config?.url?.endsWith('/auth/login')) return Promise.reject(err);` inside the interceptor before the redirect logic.
